# Vienna Life Assistant — Full Reference

## Overview
ViLife is a personal life management webapp and MCP server for Vienna-based life
admin. Provides AI chat, calendar, todos, expense tracking, travel planning,
**health tracking (doctor visits, medications, vitals)**, contacts with birthdays,
and household management (subscriptions, home tasks, pet care). All life data is
stored locally in SQLite — no cloud.

## Architecture
- **Backend**: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, FastMCP 3.4.4, SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite, uvicorn
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite 7, TailwindCSS 3, Radix UI, Lucide icons
- **Desktop**: Tauri 2.0 + NSIS installer
- **Scraping**: Playwright headless Chromium (JS SPA), httpx + BeautifulSoup (server-rendered HTML)
- **Build**: uv, just, npm

## Ports
| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| Backend + MCP HTTP | 10922 |
| Frontend (Vite dev) | 10988 |

## Data store
SQLite at `web_sota/data/vilife.db` (override with `VILIFE_DB_PATH`). First run
seeds realistic demo content; everything afterwards is user data. Schema:
`vienna_life_assistant/models.py` — calendar_events, todos, expenses,
doctor_visits, medical_conditions, medications, vitals, trips, packing_items,
travel_documents, contacts, pet_care_events, subscriptions, home_tasks.

## MCP Tools (portmanteaus)

### `vienna_life(operation)` — daily life ops
- `calendar_today`, `event_add(date_str, title, data)`, `event_update(row_id, data)`, `event_delete(row_id)`
- `todo_list`, `todo_add(title, data)`, `todo_toggle(row_id)`, `todo_delete(row_id)`
- `expense_summary`, `expense_add(data)`, `expense_delete(row_id)`
- `shopping_list` (static seed, marked mock)
- `life_brief` — calendar + todos + expenses + meds + next visit + next trip + birthdays + renewals
- `fleet_overview`, `health`, `help`

### `vienna_health(operation)` — medical status
- `visits` / `visits_add` / `visits_update` / `visits_delete` — doctor visit log
- `meds` / `meds_add` / `meds_update` / `meds_delete` — active medications, refill dates
- `vitals` / `vitals_add` — blood pressure, pulse, weight
- `conditions` / `conditions_add` — medical status (active/monitoring/seasonal)

### `vienna_travel(operation)` — travel schedule and prep
- `trips` / `trip_add` / `trip_update` / `trip_delete` — trips with countdown
- `packing(trip_id)` / `packing_add(item, trip_id)` / `packing_toggle(row_id)`
- `documents` / `document_add` / `document_delete` — passport, insurance, expiry
- `expiring` — documents expiring within 120 days

### `vienna_contacts(operation)` — people
- `list`, `add(data={name, phone, email, birthday, relationship})`, `update`, `delete`
- `birthdays` — next 30 days with days_until + age_turning

### `vienna_household(operation)` — recurring life obligations
- `subscriptions` (with monthly total) / `subscription_add` / `subscription_update` / `subscription_delete`
- `tasks` / `task_add` / `task_toggle` / `task_delete` — home maintenance with frequency
- `pet` / `pet_add` — pet care events with next-due dates

### Other
- `vienna_life_agentic(goal, ctx)` — multi-step planning via MCP sampling
- `vienna_tips(category)` — Vienna culture tips (coffee, music, museum)

## REST API
### System
- `GET /health` — server health
- `GET /api/capabilities` — tools, prompts, resources, skills
- `GET /api/v1/diagnostics` — tool list, system info (CUA-NSIS)
- `POST /api/shutdown` — graceful server termination
- `GET /api/dashboard` — DB-backed KPI stats

### Life data (generic CRUD: GET list / POST add / PUT update / DELETE)
- `GET /api/life/overview` — dashboard life pulse (events, meds, visits, birthdays, trips, renewals, tasks)
- `/api/life/calendar` — calendar events (+ `/today`)
- `/api/life/todos` — todos
- `/api/life/expenses` — expenses (+ `/summary`, `/recent`)
- `/api/life/health/visits`, `/health/medications`, `/health/vitals`, `/health/conditions`
- `/api/life/travel/trips`, `/travel/packing`, `/travel/documents`
- `/api/life/contacts`
- `/api/life/pet`
- `/api/life/subscriptions`
- `/api/life/home-tasks`

### LLM
- `GET /api/llm/providers`, `GET /api/llm/status`, `GET /api/llm/models`, `POST /api/llm/chat`

### Vienna Cultural Data
- `GET /api/vienna/music` — Burgtheater + Staatsoper (live scraped)
- `GET /api/vienna/museums` — Belvedere exhibitions (live scraped)
- `GET /api/vienna/news` / `GET /api/vienna/press` — ORF + Stadt Wien
- `GET /api/vienna/coffee` — reference guide (static)
- `GET /api/vienna/restaurants` — restaurant list + Orlik lunch menu (scraped)
- `GET /api/vienna/transport` — static reference, `"mock": true` (use mywienerlinien/gtfs-mcp for live)
- `GET /api/vienna/shopping/offers` — static reference, `"mock": true`

## Scraper Sources
| Source | Method | Cache | Data |
|--------|--------|-------|------|
| burgtheater.at/spielplan | httpx + BeautifulSoup | 30 min | plays with dates |
| wiener-staatsoper.at/kalender | Playwright Chromium (JS SPA) | 30 min | operas/concerts |
| belvedere.at/en/exhibitions | httpx + BeautifulSoup | 2 hours | exhibitions |
| gasthaus-orlik.at/mittagmenues.html | httpx + BeautifulSoup | 1 hour | lunch menu |
| wien.orf.at / presse.wien.gv.at | httpx + BeautifulSoup | 10 min | news headlines |

## Skills (6)
`vienna-life`, `vienna-alsergrund`, `vienna-transit`, `vienna-kaffeehaus`, `vienna-kultur`, `vienna-shopping`

## Prompts (6)
`life_brief_request`, `vienna_day_plan`, `alsergrund_morning`, `spar_shopping_run`, `wien_transit_check`, `kultur_abend`

## Resources (2)
`resource://vienna-life/capabilities`, `resource://vienna-life/quickstart`

## Environment
Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and configure:
- `OLLAMA_URL` — local LLM endpoint (default http://127.0.0.1:11434)
- `OPENAI_API_KEY` — cloud LLM fallback
- `VILIFE_DB_PATH` — optional SQLite path override

## LLM Providers
- **Ollama** (auto-detect port 11434)
- **LM Studio** (auto-detect port 1234)
- **OpenAI** (manual API key)

## Testing
- `uv run pytest tests/` — 27 tests, coverage gate 45%
- `npx playwright test` — fleet audit (backend health, diagnostics, page renders, zero console errors)

## Session context injection
`.claude-plugin/` (Claude Code), `.cursorrules` + `.windsurfrules` (Cursor/Windsurf),
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` (Copilot), `.opencode/skills/session-context/`
(OpenCode), `.agents/skills/` (Antigravity).
